messages:
neeraj-partners: Kicking off coordination for the Buenos Aires region with CloudScale — want to get capacity/quota, marketplace entitlement, and KMS requirements aligned. Target: soft launch in 6–8 weeks. :rocket:

ashley-sales: Thanks — I spoke with CloudScale yesterday. They can provision a 4xA100 pool for initial capacity but need marketplace SKU approval from our side. They want an ETA on entitlements + pricing docs.

maria-cloudscale: Confirmed. CloudScale partner contact is @felipe (cc'd on email). They asked about private KMS vs. partner-managed keys for enterprise customers.

ryan-ops: For private KMS we need an HSM approval path + SOC2 attestation proof. Ops will need the KMS integration docs and key rotation SLA. Can we surface that to legal/security?

neeraj-partners: @legal-bot any blockers for KMS or marketplace terms? Also need to confirm marketplace SKU naming conventions so billing maps correctly.

legal-bot: We need to review CloudScale's DPA and ensure cross-border transfer language covers AR/CL. KMS: customer-managed keys are allowed but require an encryption annex. I'll start the draft. ETA 3 business days.

ashley-sales: I'll assemble the pricing + SKU proposal. Quick question — do we want to offer a discounted reserved capacity bundle at launch? If yes, need pricing bands.

neeraj-partners: Yes, offer a 10% reserved-cap discount for 12-month commit. Keep the public marketplace price as list, then apply reserved pricing in the partner contract.

maria-cloudscale: On quotas — CloudScale default quota limit is 200 concurrent sessions per nodepool. We should request a soft quota bump to 800 for the launch week. Who owns the quota request?

ryan-ops: I can file the quota request but need exact numbers and which accounts to elevate. Can @maria-cloudscale paste the account IDs? Also need node pool sizing recommendations.

maria-cloudscale: Account IDs: cs-arg-01, cs-arg-02. For expected traffic, start with 4 nodes (4xA100), allow autoscale to 8. Batching profile: prefer seq_len 512, batching target 40ms.

neeraj-partners: Great. Action items:
- @maria-cloudscale: share account IDs and partner KMS docs (ASAP)
- @ashley-sales: pricing + marketplace SKU draft (EOD Wed)
- @legal-bot: DPA + KMS annex draft (3 business days)
- @ryan-ops: quota request + ops runbook template (tomorrow)

deploy-bot: Ticket created: PRJ-4823 "Buenos Aires marketplace entitlement + quota" assigned to @ryan-ops, due 2025-03-04. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.example/browse/PRJ-4823

ashley-sales: I also created a lightweight launch page draft for partner review — https://docs.example.com/baires-launch. Sharing with @maria-cloudscale for copy and logos.

ryan-ops: Putting a placeholder in the runbook for fallback routing to GCP-south in case the partner region hits capacity: see snippet:
```
fallback_policy:
  - primary: baires-cs
  - secondary: gcp-south
  - max_failover_tps: 50
```

maria-cloudscale: Felipe confirmed the logos and legal contact. He also asked if we can do a joint announcement press release — marketing will need final copy + date.

neeraj-partners: Keep marketing looped but don't set a firm date until legal + quotas done. Next sync: 48 hours. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:

ashley-sales: Acked. I'll post the SKU draft in the ticket and ping Felipe.

ryan-ops: I'll submit quota request now. Expect confirmation from CloudScale infra within 24 hours.

legal-bot: Draft uploaded to PRJ-4823. Please review and comment.

maria-cloudscale: Felipe will be on standby for any follow-ups.

neeraj-partners: Closing the kickoff thread; we'll reconvene after the 48h check-in.
